feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced. It is the iteration 6 design (score 937.1, the best raced so far: oval 20/20, s-bend 20/20, slalom 20/20) with one change, kd from 1.0 to 1.1 at the same sensor lead y=0.06. Everything else is unchanged: five 16 mm sensors at x=-0.03 to +0.03 m, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], kp 4.0, ki 0.05, base_speed 1.5, mass 0.40, last_direction line loss. All values are inside their contract ranges.

The damping evidence runs in one direction so far. Iteration 8 lowered kd to 0.9 at y=0.06 and fell to 865.3, with slalom dropping to 13/20 finishes, 5 off-track exits and 2 timeouts. That makes kd 0.9 clearly worse than kd 1.0. Iteration 7 raised kd to 1.1 but also moved the lead to y=0.07, so it is confounded: 930.9, with slalom line-loss events up from 0.65 to 0.95. The candidate tests kd 1.1 alone at the known-good lead, which is the one clean test of the upward direction. Because the bar is at least as good as the best raced design, and this is a single-variable step from it, approval is justified. The race will show whether 1.1 improves on 1.0 or whether 1.0 is the peak.

Plan the revision from the race telemetry. If slalom line_loss_events or max_error get worse than iteration 6 (0.65 and 0.021), or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, the damping optimum is at or near kd 1.0: return kd to 1.0 and do not go further. If slalom line_loss_events fall below 0.65 with 100% completion on all tracks, the upward direction is working, and kd 1.2 is the next step. Do not change kp: iteration 4 (kp 6) collapsed the oval and s-bend, and iteration 2 (kp 4.5) lost completions. Mass is already at its 0.40 floor.
requested_changes: If slalom line_loss_events rise above 0.65 or max_error rises above 0.021 (the iteration 6 values), or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35, return controller.kd to 1.0 with sensor y at 0.06. Basis: iteration 6 (kd 1.0) is the best measured design, and iteration 8 (kd 0.9) showed that moving kd away from 1.0 in the lower direction costs slalom finishes.

If slalom line_loss_events fall below 0.65 with all tracks at 100% completion and steering_oscillation at or below 0.35, test controller.kd at 1.2 with the same lead of 0.06. Basis: iteration 7 at kd 1.1 suggests more damping is not harmful when the lead is held, so one more upward step is worth one run.
Do not raise controller.kp above 4.0. Basis: iteration 4 (kp 6.0 with a seven-sensor array) fell to 342.7 with oval and s-bend losses, and iteration 2 (kp 4.5) lost completions on oval and s-bend.
